jobs.title: VP, Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Who we are, and what we offer: Swimlane is redefining security operations with Agentic AI automation that empowers organizations to work smarter, respond faster, and stay ahead of threats.
jobs.description:
Who we are, and what we offer:

Swimlane is redefining security operations with Agentic AI automation that empowers organizations to work smarter, respond faster, and stay ahead of threats. Our low-code platform combines automation, orchestration, and intelligent reasoning to unlock true operational autonomy across the modern SOC.

At Swimlane, we put people first. We foster a culture of innovation, trust, and continuous improvement—where your ideas matter and your work drives meaningful change. Join us and help build the next era of Agentic AI-powered security operations.

About the role

Do you love turning complex technology into stories that win deals? Do you enjoy setting the strategy behind a launch and then rolling up your sleeves to make it happen?

Swimlane is looking for a strategic, hands-on VP of Product Marketing to lead how the market understands our Agentic AI automation platform. This is a player-coach role: you'll own positioning, launches, analyst relations, and customer communications, and write much of our most important content yourself.

As VP of Product Marketing, you'll sit at the center of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You'll turn product strategy and executive vision into messaging that sells, launches that land, and analyst and press coverage that keeps Swimlane in the conversation.

This is a remote position open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

What you'll do

  • Own positioning and messaging: Define and maintain how we talk about Swimlane and our products, translating the vision of our executive and product leaders into clear, consistent messaging.
  • Lead product launches: Plan and run launches end to end, including release readiness, launch PR, web pages, sales assets, and customer announcements.
  • Drive PR for product and partner news: Work with our PR agency on launches, partner announcements, proactive media strategy, and rapid response.
  • Run analyst relations: Manage briefings and inquiries with strategic analyst firms and lead RFIs, briefings, and customer references for market reports.
  • Equip Sales to win: Own our core pitch narrative and deck, competitive differentiation content, evaluation criteria, and analyst guides, and partner with Product Management on content.
  • Own customer communications: Write and run communications to our customers, including release newsletters and adoption-focused lifecycle marketing, and oversee case studies and video testimonials.
  • Shape content and AEO/SEO strategy: Set direction for web, blog, video, ebooks, and research reports, and own the KPIs for growing organic and AI-search traffic.
  • Build partner and channel marketing: Develop joint value propositions for integrations, marketplaces, and strategic partnerships, and give our sales team the messaging and content they need.
  • Protect the brand: Keep our brand voice, style, and messaging consistent across every channel.
  • Lead your team and agencies: Set priorities, review work, and help your two direct reports grow, while managing a roster of agency partners across web, design, video, PR, SEO, and analyst relations.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a strategic storyteller who brings vision, curiosity, and a willingness to do the work.

  • Strategic storytelling: You turn complex, technical products into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with security buyers.
  • Hands-on execution: You're as comfortable writing a launch announcement or pitch deck yourself as you are setting the strategy behind it.
  • Technical curiosity: You dig into AI, automation, and SOC workflows, and you earn the trust of engineering and product teams.
  • Cross-functional influence: You bring Sales, Customer Success, and Product leaders together around one story.
  • People leadership: You set clear priorities, give honest feedback, and help your team grow their careers.
  • Urgency without compromise: You juggle multiple launches, programs, and agencies at once, move fast, and never sacrifice quality.
  • Results focus: You set clear KPIs, measure what's working, and adjust quickly.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience, including at least 4 years leading product marketing teams, in cybersecurity or enterprise software.
  • Experience marketing to security buyers such as CISOs, SOC leaders, and security engineers.
  • A proven track record of positioning products and running launches that drove pipeline and adoption.
  • Hands-on analyst relations experience with firms such as Gartner, including RFI submissions and briefings.
  • Experience running launch PR with an agency partner.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills.
  • Experience managing and developing a team and multiple agency relationships.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in security operations categories such as SOAR, SIEM, or AI SOC.
  • Working knowledge of AEO/GEO and SEO, including building content for AI search.
  • Experience building customer marketing or lifecycle programs.
  • Experience with technology alliance, marketplace, or channel partner marketing.
  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up content and design work.
  • Experience at a growth-stage company where you both set strategy and do the work.

The Perks of being a Swimlaner:

  • Competitive Benefits & Compensation
  • Stock Options
  • Training & Professional Development Opportunities
  • MacBook Pro
  • Great Company Culture
  • We value collaboration and innovation
  • Give-back Volunteering Opportunities

Here at Swimlane, our core focus is to Automate the World of Security, and we strive to represent our five core values in everything we do:

  • Punch above your weight class - We make the most of our circumstances and constantly surprise and impress with our ability to deliver.
  • Be a happy innovator - The hard problems are the fun problems to solve; we’re excited to take on difficult challenges and find creative solutions.
  • Always be leveling up - We are continuously improving, embracing change, and consuming information to better ourselves and each other.
  • Move at the speed of WOW - We work with an extreme sense of urgency, but we never compromise quality.
  • Have honesty and integrity in ‘all the things’ - We make decisions with the best of intentions, doing what is right for as many stakeholders as possible.

What’s the best thing about working at Swimlane? If you ask the team, they'll tell you it's the people. Swimlaners are innovative, collaborative, and driven by the purpose of revolutionizing the way security teams automate and respond to alerts. Headquartered in beautiful Denver, Colorado, Swimlane's staff spans 28 states and 16 countries!

The base salary range for this role is $210,000–$225,000, and will also receive a variable compensation package, which will be discussed in the interview process. Additionally, this position will receive equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

To complete your application, please submit your resume to

jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Business Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Overview The Director of Strategy & Business Analytics reports to the SVP, Head of Business Analytics.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Director of Strategy & Business Analytics reports to the SVP, Head of Business Analytics. This is a player-coach role requiring both strong individual contributor output and direct people leadership. The Director is expected to lead, mentor, and develop a team of analytics professionals while remaining actively hands-on -- building analysis, driving strategic projects, and presenting findings to senior and executive leadership. The individual must demonstrate strong business judgment, proactively identify analytical opportunities, and deliver data-driven insights that drive business decisions across functions.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of analytics professionals, fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.
  • Remain actively hands-on -- building analysis, models, dashboards, and reports alongside the team, not just directing the work.
  • Work across business functions on analytical and strategic projects as directed by the SVP, Head of Business Analytics.
  • Identify business problems, performance gaps, and opportunities that warrant analysis -- not only when asked, but by staying close to what is happening in the business.
  • Structure business questions into a clear analytical approach and determine the right method and data needed to answer them.
  • Turn work around quickly when speed matters.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership and C-suite executives. This person will be in those rooms regularly.
  • Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give business stakeholders direct visibility into their metrics.
  • Apply statistical methods to the work -- segmentation, regression, hypothesis testing, forecasting -- at the level the question requires.
  • Work with machine learning model outputs and translate results into recommendations business leaders can act on.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering on data needs, pipeline requirements, and data model gaps that affect analytical work.
  • Manage multiple projects at once and prioritize based on business impact.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years in business analytics, strategy, or a related field, with a track record of doing the analytical work directly -- not just managing it.
  • Experience leading and developing analytics teams.
  • Experience presenting analysis to C-suite or senior executive audiences.
  • Experience working across multiple business functions.
  • Experience in customer experience analytics, including analysis of satisfaction, effort, loyalty, or retention metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES, churn).
  • Experience analyzing customer journey data across multiple touchpoints or channels.
  • Experience translating customer feedback data (surveys, verbatims, contact driver analysis) into quantifiable business insights.
  • Experience working with unstructured customer feedback data, including contact reason categorization or sentiment analysis.
  • Experience analyzing customer escalation, complaint, or defection patterns.
  • Experience building customer segmentation models based on behavior, lifetime value, or risk of churn.
  • Familiarity with survey methodology and statistical weighting sufficient to interpret and validate survey-based data.
  • Financial services or consumer services experience preferred.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • SQL -- used regularly for data extraction and analysis.
  • BI and data visualization tools -- Sigma, Power BI, and/or Tableau required.
  • dbt -- working knowledge of data transformation and how it fits into an analytics workflow.
  • Statistical analysis -- descriptive statistics, regression, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and forecasting.
  • Machine learning -- enough working knowledge to use model outputs, identify appropriate use cases, and explain results to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Communication -- written and verbal, including presenting complex findings clearly to executive audiences.
  • Business judgment -- knows what questions to ask, not just how to answer them.

National Debt Relief Role Qualifications:

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.
  • Attain and maintain high performance expectations on a monthly basis.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Remain calm and professional during difficult discussions.
  • Take constructive feedback.
  • Available for full-time position.

Compensation Information

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This good faith pay range is provided in compliance with NYC law and the laws of other jurisdictions that may require a salary range in job postings. The salary for this position is $191,500 to $220,000 annually.

About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Want to learn more about who we are? Connect with us on social!

Benefits

National Debt Relief is a team-oriented environment full of rewards and growth opportunities for our employees. We are dedicated to our employee's success and growth within the company, through our employee mentorship and leadership programs.

Our extensive benefits package includes:

  • Generous Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Holidays, Volunteer Time Off, Sick Days, and Vacation
  • 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Pre-tax Transit Benefits
  • No-Cost Life Insurance Benefits
  • Voluntary Benefits Options
  • ASPCA Pet Health Insurance Discount
  • Wellness Incentive Program

National Debt Relief is a certified Great Place to Work®!

National Debt Relief is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.title: Clinical Quality Management & Training I
jobs.excerpt: Overview Who We Are Because health is personal.  That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place.
jobs.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready to turn clinical expertise into stronger care, tighter compliance, and a better-trained team?

Why This Role Matters

Behind every approved authorization, managed case, and chronic disease program is a clinical team that needs to get it right, every time. As our Clinical Specialist, you’re the person who makes that happen. You’ll audit our Utilization Management, Case Management, and Chronic Disease Management work, keep us ready for NCQA and URAC accreditation, and train the clinicians who deliver care to our members. Your work protects members, safeguards documentation integrity, and keeps our programs defensible under state, federal, and accreditation standards. When you raise the bar on quality and training, the whole organization performs better.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Audit with purpose: Conduct internal and external audits of UM, CM, and CDM processes and documentation, then prepare audit files, findings, and corrective action recommendations that drive real change.
  • Safeguard compliance: Ensure our programs meet state, federal, and accreditation requirements, including HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, URAC, and ERISA as applicable, so members are protected and the organization stays audit-ready.
  • Spot risk early: Identify quality and compliance risks and partner across teams to resolve them before they become larger problems.
  • Sharpen our playbook: Review and support SOPs and workflows to keep them aligned with regulations and clear enough to follow in practice.
  • Prepare for accreditation: Build and maintain NCQA and URAC evidence so the organization is always ready for external review.
  • Build and deliver training: Develop, maintain, and deliver role-based curriculum and onboarding for UM, CM, and CDM staff, using virtual sessions, self-paced modules, and one-on-one coaching designed for adult learners. Cover core processes such as case initiation and closure, documentation standards, high-dollar case monitoring, stop-loss notification, administrative support, customer service, and productivity expectations.
  • Measure what works: Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, observation, and performance data, then refine the content where results fall short.
  • Track competency: Maintain training records and competency documentation, monitor trends, and escalate performance concerns to leadership when needed.
  • Support corrective action: Provide coaching and training aligned to corrective action plans (CAPs), document outcomes, and keep leadership informed of progress.
  • Stay current: Keep up with changes in regulatory, accreditation, and evidence-based practice standards, and complete all required HIPAA training on time.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience:

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license required; additional licensure may be required based on program scope
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 2–4 years of experience in UM, CM, and/or DM/CDM required; managed care experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience applying adult learning principles and delivering effective training
  • Experience executing audits, including sampling, evidence validation, audit trail review, and report writing

Technical Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of applicable regulations and accreditation standards (HIPAA, CMS as applicable, NCQA, URAC)
  • Clinical documentation review and data integrity expertise
  • Education management and competency development through training oversight, performance analysis, and targeted learning interventions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Smartsheet
  • Proficiency with multiple screens and strong typing skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems in a remote environment, including Teams (on and off camera), SharePoint, shared drives, VPN, Navigate multiple platforms, Quick Links, GIAS, ADP, Confluence, and a phone system with headset; additional programs may apply based on job duties. Full system proficiency is expected after training and a 1.5-month ramp (3 months total).

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $72,000 - $80,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.
